version_tag: #138 RON'S WINNING PAIR, cleaned + clocked. Bench result: with the #136/#137 tight posts, Ron's CROSS-pair — 131_month_widesquare (wide square teeth) on 127_ballsun_slimcore — works. Sim explains it: as-modelled that mix grazes 0.126mm2, but BOTH parts shrink 0.06/side when printed, and that 0.12 of built-in backlash absorbs the mismatch (residual 0.028). LAW CORRECTED: pairs must clear AFTER shrink, not as-modelled — the matched-pair rule was over-strict. This plate prints ONLY the sun, re-carved against Ron's exact month gear (7.3mm2 removed) so the residual graze goes to 0.0000 and the sun's VALLEY is clocked to the strike line (#134). Ron KEEPS his printed 131 month gear — do not reprint it. Engagement 3.12mm (deepest of any pair), seated play 0.00deg (strike lock), mean 3.6deg. 1 part, flat, no supports, xy-comp -0.06 MANDATORY. | QUIET.
